Roles

—

Bundles of permissions assigned to members of the community.

No screen for this yet. The ladder is live and enforced on every route — viewer, suggester, editor, admin, each one a set of capabilities rather than a rank with rules written beside it. What is missing is a way to edit those sets from here, and there are enough of them that a table thrown together would be worse than the env var it replaced.

Role ownership

—

Assign roles to members of the community to grant extended editing access.

No screen for this yet. Roles are set with TENMA_GRANTS at build for now. The people and their current rank are listed under Gate ownership.
